title: Separate XRPL raw activity from economically meaningful adoption and actual capital

decisions.rule: Raw transaction count is not an adoption or economic-value metric. Count senders, not recipients, and retain bot, exchange, dust and spam classifications.
Use delivered amounts rather than declared amounts for partial payments; filter dust by delivered value; issuer-filter issued assets; measure distinct counterparties and repeat economic use.
Track DEX, payment channels, MPT/tokenized assets, permissioned domains, NFTs and x402 separately; feature activation counts alone are not institutional adoption.
Do not group stablecoins by currency code alone. Preserve issuer address and wallet role; high holder concentration may reflect custodians/exchanges rather than end-user concentration.

Never divide market-cap change by exchange net transfers and label the result a capital multiplier. Keep valuation changes, token transfers, executed trades and external cash settlement as separate variables.
A third-party channel directory and transcript spelling variants are candidate evidence only; do not equate Kamilah, Camila, Camilla and Camilla Stephenson without authoritative linkage.

feature_admission: NONE; Bitquery metrics and market-cap/netflow anecdote remain context-only pending source independence, raw-data replication and synchronized historical coverage.
